faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes GLA250e use?
faqLeft.a: The GLA250e uses the 1.3-litre M282 four-cylinder petrol engine combined with an electric motor as part of a plug-in hybrid system. It's been fitted to the H247 generation since 2020.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes GLA250e engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200 for the base engine tier. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my GLA250e?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your M282 specification and hybrid system details before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M282 GLA250e engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We rebuild the combustion engine component of the GLA250e's plug-in hybrid system to the same standard as our other Mercedes rebuilds.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used GLA250e engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my GLA250e if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a GLA250e engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most GLA250e owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
